panel.name: fields_content

check_box.name: field_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the world field
check_box.tool_tip: The shared field's view - surface tops, air labels or drainage - picked below. The drainage and air views are distance-thinned

text.name: T_field_view
text.tool_tip: The shared field's view, drawn once the world field overlay is on

combo_box.name: C_field_view
combo_box.tool_tip: Surface tops: every solid span top the cell grid holds, hue by altitude so stacked storeys read separately. Air labels: the classification per air gap, outdoors green, sheltered amber fading with the covered distance from the opening, interior red. Drainage: standing water blue and the D8 outlet chain of the filled surface. Cell spans: each solid span a flat rect at its floor and ceiling, coloured by the air state standing on it, joined by a dim line through the span's solid body. Shape census: the declared physics shapes by layer and provenance. Navmesh: the walkable Detour polygons as translucent fills with their edges, coloured by height band - the only view that needs no field grid

button.name: R_cloud_debug
button.label: Reset group
button.tool_tip: Reset every setting in this section to its default

check_box.name: cloud_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the cloud field
check_box.tool_tip: The volumetric deck's builder views, picked below

combo_box.name: C_cloud_view
combo_box.tool_tip: Cell gate and towers: the builder's 260m grid replayed across the field, green where cloud was placed and red where the sky was left open, with a stalk as tall as the noise map wants that column to climb. Column profiles: for nearby cells, the column that cell grows outlined at its true position and altitude, its width at each height exactly what the profile ramp and the anvil give a puff there - the curve as a shape, standing beside the cloud it made. Ground shadow map: the baked transmittance texels drawn as dark blots at the exact ground spot the sun projection lands them, so the overlay and the rendered shadow must coincide

check_box.name: surface_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the surface field
check_box.tool_tip: The wet/snow/puddle landing grid and its runoff traces, drawn over the ground they land on
